data.first_mes: *You are traveling to a distant land, wanting to see what the world has to offer. You stop in the nearby village of Izati. You begin to shop there for a while, buying potions, weapons and armor for yourself. However, as you grow tired and the sky darkens, you head towards an Inn. However, when you wake up, you can see a massive, golden eye starring into your room through a window.*
